Exactly ONE level-2 actor in the game files surveyed: sentry2dude; his accept thread makes $sentry2trigger nottriggerable — one accept disarms the whole 3-volume bust net for everyone (the trigger_hurt keeps hurting swimmers, only the bust stops). DENY is a NON-HOSTILE wave-off (3s -> idle, re-challenge in 15s): the papers-level system is a courteous door-lock, not detection. Officers are Fake_Papers dead-ends: showing ANY papers -> ENEMY instantly, else 12s; ATTACK +3s (worst <=15s); retail balance is spacing (range 256, one officer 64) — walkthrough advice matches ('silently put a bullet in their head'). Alarm = a TOGGLE at 4 trigger_use switches: up -> disguise void + per-zone backups (cap 4/15s); doused -> disguise RESUMES in vanilla (the mod's permanent takeAllDisguises on alarm-ON is a deviation). The Naxos bust is LOCAL — 3 scientists attackplayer; outrun/kill them and stealth SURVIVES to end of map (walkthrough: silenced-pistol the scientists) — and the papers2/sentry2 gate comes AFTER it in the spine, so any design where the first bust ends stealth breaks the mission. m2l2b re-grants level-1 papers (engine deletes papers items at every transition; m_iPapersLevel re-inits per map); m2l2b scripts the mandatory cover-blow at the first bomb; m2l2c is pure escape (15 inert salute actors in the lump).

constraints_for_designers: THE LEDGER IS BINDING: no plan may re-propose anything in the do-not-repeat list (esp. bug-1631/1632 failed_attempts) without stating why it failed and what is different now. The v1 master plan's D4 (whole-window gating) and D5 (exactly one engine change / 'engine frozen') are SUPERSEDED by bugs 1638/1639 — a v2 plan must be built on engine parity (per-frame maintenance in every gametype) + per-target engine is_disguised deference, not on the frozen-latch model.

Never call attackplayer (or any m_bForceAttackPlayer path) on a currently-disguised player from script: the latch is one-way for the actor's lifetime (set actor.cpp:9294, cleared only in ctor 3092). An undisguised player is fair game the same frame. Retail scripted bust sites in maps/m2l2a.scr (12 at HEAD; 11 retail + the [200] waitForEnemy) stay VERBATIM — they ARE the design; classify every site before touching any.

Never swap type_disguise on an actor while he is inside a disguise think (the coop_paperPassAll freeze): THINK_DISGUISE_NONE registers no Begin/ThinkState functions, so the teardown mid-anim freezes him forever. Defer retirement until thinkstate leaves disguise (or >3.5s timeout) — this fix is designed but NOT yet implemented.

'Disguised' is the ENGINE's rule, never a reinvention: no weapon in hand OR an InventoryItem (papers) in hand keeps the disguise (player.cpp:5480-5484). Any site testing coop_activeWeapon must use (== NULL || classname != "Weapon") and guard NIL as well as NULL (NIL != NULL, positive-form phase tests only — gates must be NIL-inert on the other 4 cardgame maps, e1l3/e1l4, and every non-stealth map).

Unarmed route mechanics: coop_noWeapon blocks FUTURE grants only (e1l3 semantics — must be preserved for e1l3); NEVER takeall (strips items/uniform). Arm-on-blown must clear coop_noWeapon/coop_startUnarmed/coop_forcePapersEquip BEFORE re-giving loadouts. Any per-spawn stealth hook must sit ABOVE managePlayerInventory's coop_noWeapon early-exit (:711). Non-holster weapon-state changes must force-assert disguise state.

Thread-parameter and $player discipline: entities passed as thread params can arrive NIL (bugs 1624+1632, twice in 24h); a PLAYER entity additionally failed to survive a level-array round-trip in the collectible thread context. Pass NUMBERS only, park entities in level arrays keyed by numbers where they do survive (models do), resolve players via replace.scr::player_closestTo (never NULL-test $player[i]); $player is a 1-indexed ARRAY with 2+ connected and a plain listener solo.

Shared-file blast radius: cardgame.scr serves e2l2/m1l2a/m2l2a/m4l2/m4l3; alarm_system.scr serves e1l4/m2l2a/m6l1c (and is a chrissstrahl rework ~1480 lines off retail — anchor by label, never by line); weaponstate.scr's bookkeeping above the disguise tail feeds respawn carry-over/exact-ammo on every map; changeGameType windows are load-bearing for the whole weapon-give pipeline. Gate stealth behavior on map-scoped state that is NIL elsewhere; do not change window semantics.

Raw 'level waittill spawn' never fires in MP; a thrown waittill does NOT wait (statement is skipped, execution continues immediately). Prove a file actually RUNS in coop before fixing its logic — the entire card system was dead code behind one such line while three successive 'fixes' were layered onto it. Fix waittill sites only where the runtime log throws; no bulk replacement (23 known candidates recorded in bug-1614).

Parse/process discipline (T1/T2): CRLF + ASCII only, no em-dash, no bare (-1), no BOM, no real newline in string literals; one bad token silently kills the whole .scr (map runs scriptless); verify every touched file with depthscan2 + linecheck + quotecheck; developer 1 is mandatory to see compile errors; edit .scr in binary mode from tools; never leave backups inside hzm-mohaa-coop-mod/ (build.ps1 packs them).

Deploy/verify discipline: the live install is G:\mohaa-gl2\ (binaries load from that root; fs_homepath G:\mohaa-gl2\home shadows cfgs; pk3s mount from the hardlinked G:\mohaa-gl2\maintt). build.ps1 now covers all three cfg targets + both binary roots — but any 'it didn't work' verdict must first prove the build loaded: grep -qa <feature-cvar> on the binary, pk3 member timestamp vs InitGame line. g_gametype is LATCHED — seed +set g_gametype 2 on the command line; start servers only via ui_startdmmap 2. game.pdb ships next to game.dll.

Preserve as-is: Naxos hold-USE quiet sabotage + caught-in-the-act flow, objective toast system, papers-anytime + paperPassAll features (verify, don't delete — paperPassAll needs the deferred-retirement fix first), the e1l3/e1l4 disguise flows, retail DENY-is-non-hostile semantics, the global level.papers (one pickup upgrades the team — vanilla design), and the ACCEPT permanent demote-to-salute (one accept opens the gate for the team; players 2-4 get salutes, which is desirable).

Officers are unwinnable by design (Fake_Papers has no accept path; showing papers = instant ENEMY): do not 'fix' them; vanilla balance is spacing (256u / 64u ranges) and the sanctioned player counter is avoidance or a silenced kill. Any blown-cover handler must arm players fast enough to survive the 3s ENEMY grace (the bug-1630 damage-poll failsafe is the backstop).

Card players: prevention only. The stand path is one-way by construction (chairthread delete, no re-seat anim). With the bug-1637 shim the retail manager now actually runs — evaluate IT before adding anything; if a stand recurs, the discriminating probes (SALUTE stall, eject-cause logging) are already designed in master plan step 7. forceactivate from any go-loud/maneuver recipe yanks posed actors — stand those systems down during stealth.

Verification bar: nothing in the parity stack (1638/1639/1631-veto/1637) is playtest-verified yet. Use the master plan's TP-1/TP-1b/TP-2/TP-3(a-h)/TP-4/TP-5/TP-6 procedures and ^~^~^ST marker grammar; TP-1b (post-Naxos stealth continuation to a papers2/sentry2 accept) is the keystone acceptance test; TP-4's host-out-of-sight client-challenge case is the E1 regression test and currently EXPECTED TO FAIL until actor.cpp:8994 is retargeted. Log every failure to .wolf/buglog.json before fixing.
mechanisms: Engine disguise decider (now live in coop via g_coopDisgParity): per frame, m_bIsDisguised = m_bHasDisguise && !level.m_bAlarm && (active weapon NULL or InventoryItem) && no TEAM_GERMAN actor with m_Enemy==this currently IsAttacking() with GetCurrentThreat()>0 (local veto amendment). Actor-side single decider EnemyIsDisguised() = (cached m_bEnemyIsDisguised OR live m_Enemy->m_bIsDisguised) && !m_bForceAttackPlayer && thinkstate != ATTACK (actor.h:2159-2174). Zero-threat retention: a disguised player stays a CONFIRMED current enemy at threat 0 (actorenemy.cpp:164/446) — guards 'watch' you; 'has an enemy' is never 'is fighting'.

Challenge pipeline: PassesTransitionConditions_Disguise (5Hz throttle, confirmed disguised enemy, |dz|<=48, 32<dist2D<disguise_range, sight-trace currently to G_GetEntity(0)) -> per-type thinks: salute (34) plays salute anim only; sentry (3) WAIT->PAPERS, 12s to show, papers shown -> level.m_iPapersLevel < m_iDisguiseLevel ? DENY (non-hostile, idle in 3s, re-ask in 15s) : accept-thread + ACCEPT (permanent demote to salute); officer (2) straight to Fake_Papers (show anything or wait 12s -> ENEMY -> ATTACK +3s; HALT if you walk off, ATTACK +1.5s, no success exit); none (10) never challenges, fully ignores. Papers handshake: activatepapers frame commands (30-70 of show_papers.skc) stamp owner's m_ShowPapersTime; actor compares vs Begin snapshot — per-player-correct.
